Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CVX.
Our cloud segment grew 4% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2023.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $7.41 per share.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 949 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
We expect revenues to grow approximately 4% to 25% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
